description:
Embark on a journey through enchanted realms with Krescent, the unicorn – a fantasy toy that captures the ethereal essence of the mythical unicorn stallion.

From the gentle curve designed for ergonomic bliss to the fully erect, heart-shaped flare, every part of Krescent is hand-crafted to delight the senses.

Explore Krescent in 3D

Spin it, switch between sizes, slide the diameter ring to measure it at any point, compare it with a soda or Monster can, and tap the AR button on your phone to see it at real size in your room.

Why you'll love Krescent

  • Heart-shaped flared head
  • Gentle, ergonomic curve
  • Three sizes: Small, Medium and Large
  • Suction cup base for hands-free play
  • Soft or ultra-soft silicone
  • Handmade in Australia from skin-safe silicone – Australian Made Certified

Make it yours

Pick your size and density, then list two colours and/or glitters (the colour charts are in the gallery). No colours listed? We'll choose a stunning combination for you. Made to order – ships in 2–5 business days in plain, unmarked packaging.

sections.title: Materials & Colours
sections.html:
Krescent is handmade in Australia from high-grade, skin-safe, soft-touch silicone (choose soft or ultra soft). All our silicone toys are Australian Made Certified.

Colours: list two colours and/or glitters when you order – see the colour charts in the gallery. The charts are a reference guide only: colours shift once mixed into silicone, and every pour is unique. If no colours are listed, we'll select a stunning combination for you.

sections.title: Ways to Play
sections.html:
Ride it: the suction cup base holds Krescent to any smooth, flat surface for hands-free play.

Hold it: use it by hand and let the curve and flare do the work.

Inclusive by design – made for all genders and preferences, solo or together.

sizeNote: Measured from our 3D models. Use the diameter ring in the 3D viewer to check the width at any point, or see it at true size in your room with AR.
